results.id: T1 trainer win: Fight, KO, exp, level-up, learn prompt (real keys), next turn uses new move, return to map
T2 unavailable actions and cancel: nothing consumed, always back at a usable menu
T3 wild run: faster user escapes, committed as 'ran', state unchanged apart from battle bookkeeping
T4 capture: Master Ball from the bag, captured member joins with its stable id
T5 item from the bag: Potion on the active member, consumed once and persisted
T6 failure exit: engine error mid-battle aborts cleanly, nothing committed, the event still continues
T7 save/restore outside battle + idempotent re-commit after restore
